owner_creation.analysis: src/safe_core/arena.rs owns slot storage in a branded arena. At lines 59-84 Arena owns Vec<Slot<T>> and each live slot owns Option<T>; with_arena creates an empty owner under a fresh invariant lifetime brand.
owner_creation.invariant: Every stored value has exactly one live slot owner.
limitations: Isolated preparation crate only; the production pager does not yet use this arena, and retained Rust references cannot cross its mutation APIs.
Arena ownership does not establish invariants inside an arbitrary stored T.

aliases_escapes.analysis: src/safe_core/arena.rs returns references tied to arena borrows. Handle copies contain index/generation rather than pointers; get/get_mut at 137-149 return references tied to the arena borrow. The Rc phantom brand prevents cross-thread transfer.
aliases_escapes.invariant: Handles identify objects without retaining their addresses.
limitations: Generational handles cannot validate external raw pointers retained by T.

callback_targets.analysis: src/safe_core/arena.rs consumes the higher-ranked closure synchronously. With_arena takes a higher-ranked FnOnce consumed synchronously; reserve uses a borrowed Gate, and a removed T may run its ordinary Rust destructor in its new owner.
callback_targets.invariant: No closure context escapes the branded scope.
limitations: A user destructor can execute arbitrary ordinary Rust code outside the arena contract.

invalidation.analysis: src/safe_core/arena.rs invalidates removed handles with generations. Remove at 151-166 takes the value, advances generation and retires a slot at u64 exhaustion; stale handles cannot revive during reuse.
invalidation.invariant: Slot reuse must not recreate a previous generation.

mutation_commit.analysis: src/safe_core/arena.rs reserves before publishing a new slot. Insert_gate checks live count before mutation and reserves before pushing a new slot; failed reserve returns InsertError containing the original T.
mutation_commit.invariant: Failed insertion transfers the value back to its caller.

release_pair.analysis: src/safe_core/arena.rs transfers removed values to their caller. Remove returns owned T to the caller; dropping the arena drops remaining Some(T) values and the Vec allocation through Rust destructors.
release_pair.invariant: Removal transfers ownership without duplicating T.
limitations: A removed T remains owned by its caller until that caller drops it.

error_cleanup.analysis: src/safe_core/arena.rs returns the original value on reserve failure. Capacity error leaves slot/live metadata unchanged; the drop-count test at 200-226 checks no early drop and one eventual release. Rust unwinding still owns the Vec.
error_cleanup.invariant: Insertion failure leaves the existing arena owner valid.

signals_handoff.analysis: src/safe_core/arena.rs confines the brand to ordinary main-thread use. Brand is invariant and main-thread confined; the component installs no signal handler and must be entered only in ordinary control flow.
signals_handoff.invariant: Arena mutation requires an exclusive Rust borrow.
